d: In Bihar, the NDA reached 202 seats. The Grand Alliance was reduced to 35. While it was widely believed that the Bihar election would be a close contest, the results indicate a one-sided election. But how did this happen? Where did the game change? What strategies were adopted? And who was the strategist? How did Amit Shah, the BJP's top strategist, quietly turn the tables in Bihar? He placated everyone from Magadh-Shahabad to the rebels. We will discuss Amit Shah's micro-management.
